title: mshqc: A Pure Thin-Core C++20/Python Quantum Chemistry Engine for O(V^4)-Memory-Free Orbital-Optimized Moller-Plesset Perturbation Theory
description: mshqc v2.0 is a lean, high-performance electronic structure library built on an irreducible 9-file C++20 kernel core (zero-HDF5) paired with modular Python orchestration and optional NumPy/PyTorch-CUDA FP64 backends. It implements RHF, UHF, ROHF, canonical MP2/MP3, ROMP2/ROMP3, and orbital-optimized perturbation methods (OMP2, SCS-OMP2, SOS-OMP2, O(N^4) LT-SOS-OMP2, kappa-OOMP2, OMP2.5, OMP3) across Density Fitting, full-pivoted Cholesky decomposition, and exact 4-center ERI modes, together with analytical DF nuclear gradients, geometry optimization, harmonic frequencies, pure-Python Abelian point-group symmetry, and Molden/PySCF interoperability.
